scheme_name: One-Time Settlement (OTS) scheme for pending e-challans
order_ref: Commerce & Transport Department Notification No. 11521 dated 17 September 2025
note: Odisha's OTS, approved by the cabinet in September 2025 and notified on 17 September 2025 (Notification No. 11521), let violators settle e-challans pending as of 31 July 2025 at half the prescribed fine (for example ₹5,000 licence offences settled at ₹2,500); the State Transport Authority later added more MV Act sections to the scheme's scope by a follow-up order around 10 October 2025, within the same six-month window. Challans already sent to court as prosecution reports were excluded. The scheme ran for six months from notification, so the window ended around March 2026; re-checked 1 October 2026 against odishatransport.gov.in, which still shows only the September 2025 notification with no 2026 extension or new OTS order published, so status remains closed. (Some SEO/aggregator sites republish this 2025 scheme under 2026-dated headlines without citing any new notification number — not treated as evidence of a live 2026 scheme per CONTENT_STANDARDS rule 1.)
